Q6039.reason: In 1997 China, India, and most of Africa and South Asia were still under a $1230 per-capita line, so those countries held about three-quarters of world population.

Q6181.reason: WHO cause-of-death estimates for 2017 put preterm birth complications first among under-five deaths (about 18%), ahead of pneumonia, diarrhea, and malaria.

Q9001.reason: World Bank $1.90/day estimates put 2019 extreme poverty near 8–9% of world population, closest to 10%.

Q9006.reason: GTD and Global Terrorism Index counts for 2017 are about 19,000–26,000 deaths, matching 26,000 rather than the other orders of magnitude.

Q9007.reason: UNESCO’s adult (age 15+) literacy rate was about 86% in 2015; roughly 91% is the youth rate, not the adult rate.
